questions.question: Air is important for many things. What are two different ways we use air? Name two distinct uses.
Harry grows two centimeters in one month. Why is eating food that contains calcium important for Harry's growth? Answer in a sentence.
A tiger has very large teeth called canines. A rat has very large teeth called incisors. A tiger and a rat eat different types of food. What does a rat use its incisors for? Answer in a sentence.

Betty has two magnets (A and B) and two identical metal pins. She slides Magnet A along a table until a pin is attracted to it, and slides Magnet B along the table until a pin is attracted to it. She finds that Magnet A attracts the pin from 15 cm away and Magnet B attracts the pin from 10 cm away. Steven says that both magnets are equally strong. Do you agree with Steven? Answer No or Yes, and explain your answer.
Some plants produce fruit such as apples. What is one function of a fruit?

options.text: to store water for seed germination

questions.question: What is the correct explanation for why we have day and night on Earth?

options.text: The Sun turns on its axis.
The Sun orbits around the Earth.

questions.question: Two carts each hold a magnet. The magnets face each other with their poles in this order along the line between the carts: S N ... N S (so the two ends nearest each other are both North poles). The carts are moved close together and then let go. Describe what will happen to the carts.
Which of these soil changes is due only to natural causes?

options.text: Minerals washing out due to heavy rain.
Deserts forming due to tree cutting.
Loss of minerals due to farming.
